_readme: Spec 67. avatarName/voiceName are PLACEHOLDERS (documented Gemini 3.8 Live example values), not a real pick. Gaurav must choose the actual avatar + voice in Console -> Agent Platform -> Studio -> Stream realtime (model gemini-3.8-live, Live Avatar panel) before any clip is recorded -- Google doesn't publish the avatar gallery anywhere else. Update this file with the real values first, then run agents/atlas/app/dev_scripts/record_avatar_clips.py.

chapters.script: Hi, I'm Atlas, Gaurav's AI agent. I can tell you who he is, how this site got built, or just answer whatever you're curious about. Tap a topic, or ask me anything.
Gaurav is a Cloud and AI architect. He designs and ships autonomous agent systems that connect legacy enterprise stacks to production AI, and this site is one of them, not a page describing one.

Gaurav built this whole site himself: the static frontend, the backend, and the agents running on it, spec-driven with Claude Code. Every feature started as a written spec before a line of it existed.
Ask me about Gaurav's experience, certifications, or projects, and I'll answer with real citations. I can also send him a note or your resume request, if you'd like.
